projection.purpose: Translate an explicit instruction into a checked relation package.

contract.input: Stable package ID, base revision, instruction reference and up to fifty explicit operations.
contract.precondition: Resolve document, tab, source and group IDs; never infer links from co-membership.
contract.step: Choose semantic type and interface or system exposure for every relation.
Preview all changes and prior values, resolve new endpoints and seal a digest.
contract.commit: Apply the checked package in one CAS transaction with one revision, audit and durable receipt.
contract.reject: Reject ambiguity, changed payload, stale base, unavailable new endpoint or exhausted receipt capacity.

test.given: A package has already been applied and the graph changed later.
test.when: The same actor retries the exact package.
test.then: Return its recorded receipt without new effects or a second audit.
